item.title: Bill to amend duty-related accident compensation for public-school doctors, dentists and pharmacists
item.description: AI summary: Cabinet Bill No. 8 of the 222nd Diet proposes to amend the Act on Compensation for Duty-Related Accidents of Public School Doctors, School Dentists and School Pharmacists. The House of Representatives received the bill on October 9, 2026, and passed it on November 6, 2026; the House of Councillors received it that same day. The listing records consideration in the House of Councillors, but provides no final passage, promulgation or effective date. The supplied excerpt documents legislative progress, not the proposed substantive changes to compensation.
